fields.role: The job title or certification level of the personnel.
fields.equipment: The name or identifier of the industrial equipment.
fields.access_rights: The specific permissions or restrictions granted for equipment access.
fields.rule_name: The name of the specific operational rule or alarm trigger.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger or set of circumstances when a rule applies.
fields.response: The required action or system behavior triggered by a condition.
fields.equipment_system: The specific component or subsystem of the equipment.
fields.action: The maintenance or operational task to be performed.
fields.interval: The frequency or cycle count at which a task must be performed.
fields.tolerance_target: The acceptable range or target value for a measurement.
fields.access_requirement: General requirements or protocols for accessing the area or equipment.

categories.AccessConstraint: Restrictions or requirements regarding equipment access.
categories.TriggeredResponse: Actions taken in response to a specific system condition.
categories.OperationalLimit: Defined boundaries for system performance or stability.
categories.ScheduledTask: Maintenance or calibration tasks performed on a regular interval.
